text: The project focuses on autonomous driving for special vehicles.
The core team is led by Yang Guoqing from Zhejiang University.

The project emphasizes the use of scene big data-driven approaches over rule-based programming.

The core product is the Intelligent Computing Unit (ICU) for autonomous driving.
The ICU provides environmental perception, machine learning, intelligent judgment, and safety control capabilities for autonomous driving applications.
The ICU is composed of heterogeneous multi-processor hardware, hybrid operating systems, middleware, a robot operating system, and an algorithm library.
Key technologies of the ICU include heterogeneous multi-processor fusion technology, multi-core communication technology, safety control technology, and machine learning algorithm frameworks.
The ICU enables high-performance computing for special vehicles to achieve autonomous driving.
The ICU architecture supports image processing, radar data processing, high-speed communication, motor control, and power management.
The ICU software structure includes layers for machine operation systems, control systems, and communication and data management.
Operating systems mentioned for the ICU include Linux/RT, OSEK, UCOS, and VxWorks.
